evidence.title: Billing & Payments Platform for AI-First Companies | Dodo Payments
GitHub - dodopayments/billingsdk: Modern Billing & Monetization UI Components Library

name: Billing SDK
summary: Open-source React billing and subscription UI components from Dodo Payments: pricing tables, payment forms and usage meters.
description: A set of type-safe React components from Dodo Payments for billing and subscription screens, built with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS to sit alongside shadcn/ui. Pricing tables in eight variants, subscription management with invoice history and usage tables, payment forms and method selectors, usage meters, cancellation flows and promotional banners, plus a CLI that generates framework API routes. Install components individually or scaffold a project; GPL v3 licensed.
contains: pricing tables in eight variants, incl. feature-comparison
subscription management: usage-based pricing, invoice history, usage table, update plan, cancellation flows
payment details forms, payment method selector, success and failure dialogs
usage meters (linear and circular), billing dashboard and billing settings
CLI generates framework API routes, React hook and Dodo Payments client
themes: classic, minimal, custom tokens; light and dark mode via CSS variables
